About.MetaDescription: Open Tax Calendar is a free, open-source and collaborative easy to access database for Tax obligations and due dates

Why.title: Why
Why.content: With the Open Tax Calendar project, we are addressing the lack of structured data for Tax due dates.

What.title: What
What.content: Open Tax Calendar is a free, open-source and collaborative easy to access database for Tax obligations and due dates.

How.title: How
How.content: Thanks to AI technologies, open-source guide-lines and collaborative interface, we are building a tool for everyone to use and enjoy.
